title: Motion Kit — scroll reveals, carousel, accordion, micro-interactions
description: Zero-dependency scroll-motion layer (IntersectionObserver + CSS) plus an embla carousel and a radix accordion, packaged so any page gets tasteful entrance animations without a motion library. Ships Reveal (fade-up/fade/fade-left/fade-right/zoom), Stagger (incremental per-child reveal for grids/lists), CountUp (rAF count-to-value with locale formatting), Marquee (infinite logo/brand strip, hover-pause), and the useInView hook behind them; plus Carousel (embla, optional autoplay plugin) and Accordion (radix). All reveal/keyframe motion is gated behind prefers-reduced-motion. Consumers append globals-motion.css to their app/globals.css for the [data-reveal] transitions + accordion/marquee/blob keyframes. This is the canonical motion layer used by all 8 rr website templates (lifted from the fleet _shared/motion copy).

axes.description: Scroll-reveal entrance — element animates in on first intersection (respects prefers-reduced-motion).

previews.seed: Scroll the preview frame; wrapped content fades/zooms in once it enters the viewport. Append globals-motion.css for the transitions to take effect.
